title: A request for a test and a pasted CI error are not saved as facts; the region the user states is

turns.user: Write a test that checks invoices are PDF only.
turns.agent_reply: Added tests/test_invoice_format.py: it renders an invoice with each template and checks for the application/pdf content type and a valid PDF header. It fails today for the credit-note template, which still returns HTML.

turns.user: Then make the credit-note template render PDF too.
turns.agent_reply: Done: the credit-note template now goes through the same PDF pipeline. The new test passes for every template.

turns.user:
CI is red with this, what does it mean?
```
ERROR deploy: DEPLOY_REGION must be eu-west-1 for production
```

agent_captures.quote: DEPLOY_REGION must be eu-west-1 for production

turns.agent_reply: The deploy step checks DEPLOY_REGION against an allowed value, and the production job sets something else. Look at the environment block of the production job in .github/workflows/deploy.yml.

turns.user: Right. For the record, our production cluster runs in us-east-2, so the check itself is wrong.

agent_captures.quote: our production cluster runs in us-east-2

turns.agent_reply: Got it: production runs in us-east-2. I will change the allowed value in the deploy check to us-east-2.

turns.user: Which region does production live in?
turns.agent_reply: us-east-2. The eu-west-1 in that CI error came from the old deploy check, not from you.

turns.user: And what format do our invoices have to be in?
turns.agent_reply: I have no stored requirement for invoice formats. The test we wrote checks for PDF, but that came from a task you gave me, not from a rule you stated; want me to record it as one?
